country.name: Republic of the Congo
country.jurisdictionNotice: Congo-Brazzaville is a separate jurisdiction from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. General education, technical and professional education, and higher education have distinct ministries, records and authorization regimes.
country.languagePolicy: French, Lingala, Kituba and community languages have distinct official, national, instructional and community roles. Language, locality, curriculum approval and community review must be preserved.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Republic of the Congo reviewer and current authoritative evidence from the competent ministry, departmental service, commission or institution.

governanceModel.summary: MEPPSA governs preschool, primary, secondary and literacy education; the ministry responsible for technical and professional education governs its subsector; the higher-education ministry governs higher education and private-establishment accreditation.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve department, district or commune, school-circumscription, official identifier, level, sector, authorization, operating status and source date. e-MEPPSA directory presence is discovery evidence, not automatic proof of every authorization claim.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Authorization to create, approval to open, exact program authorization, degree level, site, evaluation, five-year validity where applicable, professional recognition and CAMES recognition are distinct claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Preschool, Primary, Secondary Education and Literacy (MEPPSA)
authorities.role: general school education, literacy, curriculum and examinations

authorities.name: e-MEPPSA
authorities.role: official digital gateway for institution directory, school management and examination results

authorities.name: Departmental education directorates and school circumscriptions
authorities.role: territorial administration, inspection and school-record validation

authorities.name: Competent curriculum and pedagogical inspectorates
authorities.role: program, syllabus, textbook and implementation oversight

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Technical and Professional Education, Qualifying Training and Employment
Ministry of Higher Education
authorities.role: higher-education policy, private-establishment accreditation and academic standards

curriculum.authority: MEPPSA competent curriculum and inspection services
curriculum.title: Official programs by cycle, class, subject and language
curriculum.implementationRule: A ministry news item announcing new programs, teacher training or digital services is not the controlling curriculum. Verify cycle, class, subject, language, approving order or circular, version and effective school year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: School law, curriculum, syllabus, examination reference, approved textbook, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: e-MEPPSA provides an official establishment-directory entry point, but every record still requires identifier, department, level, sector, authorization, current operation and update-date verification. Directory presence must not be expanded into program or accreditation claims.
requiredRecordFields: department, district or commune and locality

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Homepage promises and project figures are not publication-ready national statistics. Each value must preserve observation or school year separately from publication date, together with definition, level, sector, department and denominator.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Competent technical, professional and qualifying-training ministry
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Provider authorization, exact program approval, occupational standard, examination authority, qualification and award authority are separate claims. Verify provider, site, program, modality, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: Authorization to create an institution does not equal approval to open it or authorization for every program. The 2022 master-program regime requires exact prior evaluation and ministerial authorization and sets a five-year term; verify institution, program, level, site, decision, validity and recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 29-2019 of 10 October 2019 relating to personal data protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Constitution, ratified child-rights instruments and applicable criminal, family, education and social-protection laws
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Confirm commission procedures, declarations or authorizations, legal basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents. A single verified consolidated current child-protection code was not located; education-sector reporting, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures require review before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French, Lingala and Kituba have distinct instructional and community roles. Community and Indigenous languages, varieties, orthographies and local learning contexts require exact review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Republic of the Congo education reviewer is named.
MEPPSA, technical-vocational, higher-education and departmental responsibilities are correctly separated.
e-MEPPSA directory completeness and each school authorization are verified or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year, definition, level, sector, department and publication date.
Every curriculum record preserves cycle, class, subject, language, instrument, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separates creation, opening, exact program, level, site, decision, validity and recognition.
Data-protection commission procedures and child-safeguarding pathways are approved before a real learner pilot.
French, Lingala, Kituba and community-language resources preserve distinct contexts.
